channel.title: Taste of Japan — Tokyo Restaurant Guide
channel.description: A guide to real Japanese restaurants in Tokyo for international visitors, with practical tips, a mini phrasebook, and neighborhood guides.

image.title: Taste of Japan — Tokyo Restaurant Guide

item.title: Where to Eat in Tokyo: 18 Neighborhoods
item.description: Tokyo doesn't have one dining scene — it has one per neighborhood. A guide to the 18 areas in our directory, from Ginza's polished counters to Toyosu's market sushi, with each area linked to its pre-filtered listings.

item.title: Eating Out in Japan: A First-Timer's Guide
item.description: How to choose a restaurant, order without Japanese, mind your manners, and pay. Everything you need to dine out in Japan with confidence, even without a word of Japanese.

item.title: Eating Well in Tokyo on a Budget
item.description: What each price level actually gets you in Tokyo — from under-¥1,000 ramen and curry to high-end sushi and wagyu — with real restaurants from our directory at every tier.

item.title: What to Eat in Japan by Season
item.description: Japanese cuisine follows the seasons closely. A month-by-month guide: spring bamboo shoots and sakura mochi, summer unagi and cold noodles, autumn sanma and matsutake, winter oden and fugu.

item.title: Vegetarian & Vegan Dining in Tokyo
item.description: The dashi issue explained, how to communicate your needs in Japanese, and which restaurants in our directory can accommodate plant-based diets.
